footprint_caveat: This describes what the installer wrote to disk. It does not describe runtime access. A least-privilege policy derived only from this data will over-grant on the install tree and under-grant on runtime paths (/tmp, /dev, sockets, resolver config). Merge with runtime observation before enforcing.
